identity.summary: Linguistic and structural grammar for AI-parsable signal narration; coherence-aware framing vocabulary for Triadic diagnostic outputs

purpose.role: Linguistic and structural grammar for AI-parsable signal narration; coherence-aware framing vocabulary for Triadic diagnostic outputs
purpose.description: Grammar for Intelligence defines the canonical linguistic and structural grammar used to narrate Triadic diagnostic outputs — DDRs, DAMs, and CDCSs — in a form that is both human-legible and AI-parsable. It specifies vocabulary for coherence-aware framing (signal declarations, state assertions, causal linking), structural grammar rules for DDR narrative sections, and coherence tone markers (coherent, fragmented, drifting, synthesized). It is the narration grammar consumed by the TRIADIC_REGIME_SYNTHESIZER when generating DDR prose.
purpose.spine_role: Narration grammar for Triadic Regime Synthesizer DDR prose generation
